ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
124
STUDY 168
Beige Knit Crop & Denim Maxi
Rights check
Source: 25054.jpg
Fresh, casual, polished
WORKING NOTES
- The beige knit crop and mermaid denim are the key
shapes.
- Keep the frayed hem for a relaxed, lived-in finish.
Try this: Keep the frayed hem for a relaxed finish.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight black hair stands against a soft
gray backdrop. She wears a beige
short-sleeve knit crop top with a
diamond-texture pattern and a front tie
with cord detail. A dark wash denim
maxi skirt with a mermaid flare and
frayed asymmetric hem sits at the waist.
She holds a black quilted shoulder bag
and wears chunky black slide sandals.
Her expression is calm and direct. Soft,
even studio light. Palette of sand, indigo
denim, and black. Fresh and casual, in
the style of a spring lookbook.
